steps.content: [You have a new error ticket!]

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: Alright, it looks like everything is going well.
Rise swiftly handles the error ticket, drafts an email to Moore, then lets out a cautious sigh of relief.
Meanwhile, in the developers' group...
Rise shakes her avatar in this digital space, ready to execute her task, but the system prompt that pops up prevents her from proceeding.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: ...Insufficient permissions again... Are they extra cautious with interns because there was a mole here?

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: But if this continues, I won't be able to gather any information. I have to come up with a plan...
A message from Moore appears in front of her.
If I'll be here for a few more days...

At the same time, Hecate finally escapes the excited dreaming crowd. She walks and listens from a secluded area, searching for those who might be in agony, hoping to extract energy to summon her Nightmare.

steps.speaker: Person in the Dream
steps.content: Ugh...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...Is-is that a nightmare?
If it's a nightmare, it might resonate with my Mania and bring back my Nightmare... I'll give it a try.
She gently places her hand on the figure's head and whispers...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Nightmare... come back.
Several wisps of shadows flow out from its consciousness, condensing into thick reams that fall to the ground. They are covered in red crosses, looking grim and eerie.
They look like Hella's homework book, which can indeed be a nightmare for some under certain circumstances.
But such a dream is free from Mania and distortion, and cannot provide energy for battle.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...Sigh.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, the nightmares in this world are weak. Please hold on a bit longer. I will try my best to recover my Nightmare and return to you.
The figure, having lost its Nightmare, now appears peaceful and now notices Hecate.

steps.speaker: Person in the Dream
steps.content: <size=26>Softly</size> (You took away my nightmare...)

steps.speaker: Person in the Dream
steps.content: <size=26>Joyfully</size> (You made my dreams sweet again. Thank you!)
It jumps up happily, looking very excited.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Your sweet dreams have nothing to do with me. I did nothing!
